hero.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: transparent PNG website hero illustration, production artwork.
Input image 1: visual style and composition reference ONLY. Extract/recreate the central hero illustration, not the entire website.
Primary request: Recreate extremely faithfully the central hand drawn cartoon from the supplied reference. On the left, a thoughtful yellow rubber-hose cartoon character with a very large round yellow head, tall white oval eyes looking up/right, black pupils, tiny worried mouth, right hand on chin, small yellow body, black bent knees/shorts, chunky white sneakers with black outlines, sitting on a small cream cushion. To its right at foot height, a stack of four horizontal books, alternating pale lavender and golden yellow, white pages, thick irregular black ink outlines. Above its head, a tilted thin black oval thought balloon connected by two small circles. At upper right, a tilted rectangular pastel lilac sticky note held at the top by one short piece of black tape, handwritten black words and a small drawn smiley at the bottom. Match relative placement, gestures, colors, line thickness and warm playful editorial doodle style closely to the image.
Composition: isolated illustration full composition only, very tight fitting square-ish portrait canvas. Oval thought balloon at upper left, lilac sticky at upper right, character lower left, books lower right. Ground line beneath shoes/books. Preserve the white fills of eyes, shoes and pages while background is truly transparent.
Text exact: Thought balloon handwritten Cyrillic “Там точно есть подвох...” in two lines. Sticky note handwritten Cyrillic “Хорошие загадки делают день лучше” stacked in short lines. Book spine labels uppercase Cyrillic from top to bottom: “ЛОГИКА”, “ИНТУИЦИЯ”, “ЭРУДИЦИЯ”, “УДОВОЛЬСТВИЕ”.
Palette: warm yellow #ffd269, ink black #111110, offwhite shoes and page fills, soft lilac #d8cff9. Flat colored pencil/gouache texture, hand drawn black marker contours, slight natural imperfect strokes.
Constraints: transparent RGBA background, no white rectangle backdrop, no website UI, no headings, no buttons, no extra text, no shadows outside subtle illustration texture, no watermarks. Keep exact central illustration composition of the reference.

cards.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: transparent horizontal sprite sheet of FIVE small hand drawn game illustrations for a website.
Input image 1: the exact art style and five game-card doodles to match, shown in the reference's middle row. Recreate ONLY the five doodles, no card backgrounds, UI, headings or buttons.
Primary request: Five separate complete illustrations, in one clean horizontal row, generously separated by equal transparent gutters. Each occupies exactly one-fifth of the canvas, with blank transparent safety margin around each, with all five centered vertically and the same apparent scale. Very wide 5:1 composition. Thick naturally irregular black marker ink outlines, warm offwhite filled paper, light colored pencil texture, friendly handmade editorial doodles. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no drop shadows.
Illustration 1 (leftmost, first fifth): a slender gold upright signpost with two offwhite outlined opposing arrow signs, upper sign left-pointing with Russian “ДА”, lower sign right-pointing with Russian “НЕТ”, like the reference.
Illustration 2 (second fifth): five separate slightly tilted offwhite letter tiles arranged in a gently rising row; black handwritten Russian letters and blanks exactly “С _ О _ О”. Rounded-square tiles, black outlines. Fits entirely in own fifth.
Illustration 3 (middle fifth): three blank offwhite playing cards with rounded corners and black outlines, loosely fanned; front center card upright and displaying a bold handwritten black question mark “?”.
Illustration 4 (fourth fifth): a slightly tilted square double-outlined offwhite picture frame, containing black silhouette mountains and a small golden sun; a playful black-and-white cartoon eye with three eyelashes sits overlapping the frame upper right.
Illustration 5 (rightmost, last fifth): two diagonally tilted rectangular offwhite placards, top one reading bold black Russian “ПРАВДА”, bottom one pale salmon reading bold black “ВЫМЫСЕЛ”, with short black sketch emphasis strokes at their outer sides.
Constraints: Exactly five illustrations in this order. Very clear transparent spaces between them. Every illustration upright, fully visible, no clipping, no overlapping adjacent asset. No objects from the reference's hero. Do not include colored card backgrounds, circles, arrows, web page UI, labels beyond the requested lettering, or watermark. Match reference doodles closely.
